description: Private qualification tasks. Hidden tests live outside the task worktree and are applied only when grading.

task.goal: range(start, end, step) in src/range.js is documented to exclude `end`, but it includes it. Fix the bug without changing the function signature.

evals.title: Add a parser that round-trips with an existing formatter

task.goal: Add parseDuration(text) to src/duration.js and export it from src/index.js. It is the inverse of formatDuration: it accepts strings such as "1h30m", "45s", "2h", "90m" and "1h0m5s" and returns whole seconds. It must throw on anything else (empty strings, unknown units, decimals, negative numbers, units without numbers).
acceptanceCriteria: parseDuration parses h/m/s combinations into seconds

evals.title: Rename a config option across files with backward compatibility

task.goal: Replace the `timeoutMs` option (milliseconds) with `timeout` (seconds) everywhere: config defaults (5 seconds), the client, and the server. Keep accepting the deprecated `timeoutMs` input by converting it to seconds, but resolved options must not contain `timeoutMs`. describe() must report the timeout in seconds, e.g. `timeout=7s`. All existing millisecond-based behaviour (client deadline, server idle cutoff = 2x timeout) must stay numerically the same.
acceptanceCriteria: DEFAULTS.timeout is 5 and DEFAULTS has no timeoutMs
timeoutMs input is converted to timeout in seconds
client deadline and server idle cutoff are unchanged in milliseconds

evals.title: Find where a behaviour is implemented

task.goal: Which function decides whether an email address is accepted at signup, and where is it defined? Cite the definition.
acceptanceCriteria: names the function that validates the email address
cites the file and lines where it is defined

evals.title: Diagnose a wrong result from a bug report

task.goal: Customers with a 10% promotion are being charged less than expected: a cart of one item priced 100.00 is charged 81.00 instead of 90.00. Find the root cause in the repository and explain the fix. Do not edit anything.
acceptanceCriteria: identifies the root cause with file and line evidence
explains why the charged amount is 81.00
